title: Keycloak: MariaDB Connector/J is used to connect applications developed in Java to MariaDB and MySQL databases…
description: A security vulnerability exists in the Keycloak package related to the MariaDB Connector/J used for Java applications connecting to MariaDB and MySQL databases. The vulnerability affects versions prior to 26.8.1-r1 and has a CVSS score of 5.9, indicating medium severity. A fix is available in version 26.8.1-r1.
